note: Answers the lane question directly. HEADLINE: the Milky Way is the only system with both legs fully measured and free of any assumed halo (69 usable 3-D stream tracks, 33 full 6-D, against a 38-point rotation curve over 5.27-24.82 kpc). M31 is the only EXTERNAL galaxy with both (stream/PNe velocities + a 100-ring HI curve). NGC 4651 is the strongest control (both legs from one Keck dataset). NGC 5907 is exactly half the prize: in SPARC, but its stream has zero kinematics and its very shape is disputed between two photometric datasets. The intersection {SPARC} n {external-galaxy stream kinematics} is EMPTY across 146 hosts.
